title: Email Marketing Benchmarks & Industry Statistics | Mailchimp

facts.fact: According to Mailchimp's own data, the average unique open rate for the Business + Finance industry is 31.35%, as of December 2023.
According to Mailchimp's own data, the average unique open rate for the Non-Profits industry is 40.04%, as of December 2023.
According to Mailchimp's own data, the average unique open rate for the Education + Training industry is 35.64%, as of December 2023.
According to Mailchimp's own data, the average unique open rate for the Ecommerce industry is 29.81%, as of December 2023.
According to Mailchimp's own data, the average unique open rate across all users is 35.63%, as of December 2023.
Mailchimp recommends subject lines use no more than 9 words.
facts.quote: We recommend you use no more than 9 words and 60 characters.

facts.fact: Mailchimp's research indicates subject lines should use no more than 3 punctuation marks.
facts.quote: Our research shows that it’s best to use no more than 3 punctuation marks per subject line.

facts.fact: According to Mailchimp's research, subject lines should use no more than 1 emoji at a time.
facts.quote: According to our research, you should use no more than 1 emoji at a time.

facts.fact: Mailchimp's industry benchmark data only included campaigns sent to at least 1,000 subscribers.
facts.quote: We only tracked campaigns that went to at least 1,000 subscribers.

facts.fact: The benchmark data on the page was last updated in December 2023.
facts.quote: The data provided on this page was last updated in December 2023

facts.fact: The open rate is defined as the percentage of recipients who open an email.
facts.quote: The open rate measures the percentage of recipients who open an email

facts.fact: Mailchimp describes the click rate as a percentage that shows how many successfully delivered emails prompted subscribers to click and explore further.
facts.quote: represented as a percentage, sheds light on how many successfully delivered emails prompted subscribers to click and explore further.

facts.fact: Mailchimp gives an illustrative marketing goal of adding 500 more subscribers to an email newsletter; this is a hypothetical example, not a measured result.
facts.quote: adding 500 more subscribers to your email newsletter

facts.fact: Mailchimp gives an illustrative marketing goal of increasing the total number of products sold by 20%; this is a hypothetical example, not a measured result.
facts.quote: increasing the total number of products you sell by 20%

facts.fact: Mailchimp's own data suggests an optimal email open rate of about 34.23 percent, though the target varies by industry.
facts.quote: According to our data, you should aim for somewhere around 34.23 percent, though the industry your business is in may change that figure.

facts.fact: According to Mailchimp's data, government emails have the highest average email open rate at 40.55 percent.
facts.quote: our data shows that the highest average email open rate is 40.55 percent for government emails

facts.fact: According to Mailchimp's data, vitamin supplement emails have the lowest average email open rate at 27.34 percent.
facts.quote: the lowest average email open rate is 27.34 percent for vitamin supplement emails

facts.fact: Based on Mailchimp's data, the optimal click-through rate for an email marketing campaign is 2.66 percent.
facts.quote: Based on our data, the optimal CTR for an email marketing campaign is 2.66 percent

facts.fact: The page states that click-through rates may range from 1 to 5 percent depending on the industry.
facts.quote: however it may range from 1-5 percent depending on the industry.

facts.fact: According to Mailchimp's data, the vitamin supplements industry has the lowest click-through rate of any industry at 1.19 percent.
facts.quote: The lowest CTR of any industry is the vitamin supplements industry, with 1.19 percent

facts.fact: According to Mailchimp's data, the government industry has the highest average click-through rate at 4.58 percent.
facts.quote: the highest average CTR is 'government', with 4.58 percent.

facts.fact: The page recommends that businesses strive to have at least 1,000 email subscribers regardless of business size.
facts.quote: you should strive to have at least 1000 subscribers.

facts.fact: The page states that, on average, about half of an email list's subscribers will be interested in the business's products or services.
facts.quote: On average, half of your email list subscribers will be interested in your product or services

facts.fact: The page defines click-through rate as total clicks divided by the total number of emails delivered in a campaign.
facts.quote: The CTR is typically determined by taking the total clicks and dividing that by the total number of emails delivered

facts.fact: The page states that businesses must comply with anti-spam laws such as the CAN-SPAM Act in the United States and the GDPR in the European Union.
facts.quote: You must comply with applicable laws, including anti-spam laws, such as the CAN-SPAM Act in the United States or the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) in the European Union

facts.fact: The page advises that businesses obtain explicit consent from individuals before adding them to an email list and include a link to the privacy policy during the opt-in process.
facts.quote: the first step is obtaining explicit consent from individuals before adding them to your email list.
